{{Quote|Trust me. We're getting that spice!|Turk Falso|audio=WereGettingThatSpice-TheGunganGeneral.flac|<ref name="The Gungan General">{{TCW|The Gungan General}}</ref>}}
'''Turk Falso'''<ref name="TGG Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-gungan-general-episode-gallery|text="The Gungan General" Episode Gallery}} {{C|Excerpt: ''Hondo Ohnaka and '''Turk Falso''' discuss their incoming ransom, eager to get a shipment of spice from the Republic.''}}</ref> was a [[Gender|male]] [[Weequay]] member of the [[Ohnaka Gang|Ohnaka]] [[pirate]] gang. Falso was present when [[Hondo Ohnaka]] captured [[Count]] [[Dooku]]—leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]]—on [[Florrum]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. When a ransom of one million [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] in [[spice]] was to be paid for Dooku's capture by the [[Galactic Republic]],<ref name="Dooku Captured" /> Falso sought to take the spice for himself, killing the diplomat [[Senator]] [[Kharrus]] in the process. His plan to betray Ohnaka failed, however, so Falso and another Weequay attempted to make an escape from Florrum. Before they could depart, Dooku escaped his [[prison]] and [[Telekinesis|used]] [[the Force]] to make Falso kill [[Barb Mentir|his pirate ally]] before choking him to death.<ref name="The Gungan General" />

==Biography==
Turk Falso was part of the [[Ohnaka Gang]],<ref name="Dooku Captured" /> despite disliking taking orders from [[Hondo Ohnaka]].<ref name="Join the Battle" />

===Capture of Dooku===
[[File:TurkFalso.png|thumb|left|180px|Turk Falso]]
Ohnaka's gang found [[Count of Serenno|Count]] [[Dooku]] on [[Vanqor]], after he escaped from a [[Skirmish at Vanqor|battle]] between him and two [[Jedi]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker]]. Ohnaka offered Dooku passage to [[Florrum]], a planet six [[parsec]]s away. When Dooku arrived on Florrum, he was captured by the pirates. Ohnaka contacted the [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] and demanded the Republic to pay 1,000,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] in [[spice]] in exchange for the captured Count. [[Jedi Knight]]s Kenobi and Skywalker were tasked to go to Florrum and confirm if the pirates did indeed capture Dooku. Upon their arrival, Falso scanned them with a [[portable scanner]] for any hidden weapons and lead them to his leader. They met Ohnaka and saw Dooku locked up in a [[containment field]] in his cell. Kenobi contacted [[Supreme Chancellor|Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] to confirm the capture of Dooku. Palpatine sent [[Senator]] [[Kharrus]] and [[Junior Representative|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks]] on a [[Mission to Florrum|ransom mission]]. Later Falso invited Kenobi and Skywalker to join them in a Weequay banquet.<ref name="Dooku Captured" />

===Deception and death===
Falso tried to double cross his [[captain]], Hondo Ohnaka, the leader of the [[pirate]] gang on the backwater [[Planet|world]] of Florrum, to steal the spice [[ransom]] for himself. He ordered a fellow pirate, [[Barb Mentir]], to shoot down [[Nu-class attack/transport shuttle|the ship]] carrying the spice in order to get it. His plan worked, partially, but the [[clone trooper]]s and Binks survived the crash, killing only the [[Clone trooper pilot|pilots]] and Kharrus. After Falso heard that there were possible survivors from Mentir, he went to acquire the spice himself along with some other pirates, traveling towards the crash site utilizing [[Starhawk speeder bike|swoop bikes]]. Falso stole the spice from the wreckage of the ship located in the [[Doshar fields]], but Binks and the surviving clones got it back after chasing Falso and his gang by riding on [[skalder]]s, creatures native to Florrum.<ref name="The Gungan General" />

[[File:Falso_choked.png|thumb|right|250px|Falso being [[Telekinesis|Force choked]] by Count Dooku]]
After returning to the pirate base, Falso said to Ohnaka that the Republic hadn't send the spice, but an army. He asked if he could send [[WLO-5 speeder tank|tanks]] to destroy the army. Ohnaka gave him permission, but Falso's plan failed. One of the tanks was accidentally destroyed by Binks, who rammed it into one of the power lines to the [[Hondo's complex|pirate outpost]]. The remaining two tanks were attacked by [[Clone Commander|Commander]] [[Stone (clone trooper)|Stone]] and the clone troopers and both tanks were captured. They used them to quickly go to Ohnaka's pirate base and get in unnoticed. Falso was about to flee in a [[Flarestar-class attack shuttle|''Flarestar''-class attack shuttle]] knowing that Ohnaka would figure out his betrayal, when he was suddenly choked and lifted into the air by an unseen force. As Mentir watched, Dooku, who had escaped from the pirate prison during the power loss in the base, emerged from the shadows and manipulated Falso into shooting the other pirate in the chest before crushing Falso's throat with [[the Force]], killing him. Dooku then escaped Florrum in the [[Weequay]] [[Unidentified Flarestar-class attack shuttle (Ohnaka Gang)|saucer craft]], which the two pirates had been planning to escape in.<ref name="The Gungan General" />

==Personality and traits==
Turk Falso was a Weequay [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Dooku Captured" /> who stood at 1.92 [[meter]]s (6 [[Foot|feet]], 4 inches),<ref name="Join the Battle" /> and had [[Color|gray]] [[eye]]s and gray skin.<ref name="Dooku Captured" /> Falso was a scheming individual who was more loyal to his own interests than that of the Ohnaka Gang. Daydreaming of being his own boss, he was willing to disobey orders and instead form his own plans.<ref name="Join the Battle" />

==Skills and abilities==
Turk Falso was exceptionally skilled in combat and [[speeder bike]] [[pilot]]ing. He also excelled in scheming,<ref name="Join the Battle" /> and attempted to steal the ransom the Republic sent to the Ohnaka Gang.<ref name="The Gungan General" />

==Equipment==
Falso was armed with a [[Weequay blaster pistol]].<ref name="The Gungan General" />

==Behind the scenes==
Falso was voiced by [[Greg Ellis]] in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] animated series.<ref name="Dooku Captured" />
